original_html.authority: Primary-downloaded official filing HTML; original response bytes copied unchanged from /tmp/round12-official-26-19-016.htm.

extraction.original_html: Primary downloaded public official HTML; copied byte-for-byte to original.htm. Primary reports curl download with no credentials.
extraction.parser: extract_source.py uses Python standard-library HTMLParser; converts HTML character references; excludes head/style/script; retains all body text nodes and records each anchor href and label separately. Explicit block-boundary newlines are introduced; source text whitespace is retained.
extraction.parsed_text: parsed-body.txt is the deterministic full readable body text. Existing 26-19-016.txt is preserved as the browser document.body.innerText model source.

comparison.detail: Parsed body and browser text have identical token sequences under str.split() whitespace-only comparison; differences are page-layout separators and source spacing around linked statutory citations. Both unnormalized captures are retained.

extraction.preliminary_html: 26-19-016.html is retained as the initial escaped visible-text wrapper recorded in READY.initial.json; original.htm is the authoritative raw response archive.

source_uncertainties: Source states the comment window as August 7 through October 20, 2026.
Source prints the mailing location postal codes as Olympia, WA 98504 [98501]. Both values are retained verbatim.
Preproposal WSR citation appears as 26-15-[0]21. It is retained verbatim and not resolved.
